elements.text: February MVP target; expansion follows results

elements.name: roadmap-summary-subtitle
elements.text: Planning windows from December 2026 through Q4 2027; readiness governs release.

elements.name: roadmap-summary
elements.text:
Stage	Timing	Compass focus
0  Prove	Dec 2026	Demonstrate one journey; agree intent, context,
Pega overlap, interface and accountable owners.
1  MVP	Feb 1–28, 2027
Launch target	One journey with context before routing. Self-service
requires an accepted voice / AI destination.
2  Widen	Mar–Jun 2027
Monthly releases	Expand validated intents toward the Top 20 ambition;
separate agent-assist features need their own acceptance.
3  Routing pilots	Q2 discovery
Q3 2027 proposed	Design all-LOB routing, digital context, callbacks and
supervisory assistance; pilot selected scopes.
4  Expand	Q4 2027
Proposed	Scale proven inbound scope; retire only accepted
Pega AI functions. Outbound / new channels remain future.

elements.name: roadmap-conflict
elements.text:
Schedule conflict: source plan has Mar–Apr pilot / May–Jun production.
February remains a target; reconcile scope, dependencies and owner-approved readiness.
